تستصبروا (form X)
# تَسْتَصْبِرُوا (tastaṣbirū) /tas.tasˤ.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# تُسْتَصْبَرُوا (tustaṣbarū) /tus.tasˤ.ba.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
